verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own AI Notetaker, which joins interviews, records and transcribes them, and fills the interview feedback form (the per-stage scorecard) with notes. That covers the core recording, transcription and scorecard distillation. Nothing in the pack addresses candidate consent, and the notetaker is backed by a single docs sentence. missing for 10: candidate consent/recording-disclosure handling, explicit AI summary detail beyond notes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews get AI notes and summaries — recorded, transcribed, and distilled into the scorecard with candidate consent handled

citations.quote: Dover AI Notetaker joins your interviews, records and transcribes them, and fills in your interview feedback form with notes.
Create a form once, assign it to an interview stage, and every interviewer scores candidates the same way.
